_doc: Values of run MA for CAR-V (logs/MA.events.txt, logs/MA.RUN_INFO, logs/MA.time.txt): simulation (simulate.sh) of a git archive of tag r11-multiapp-rc1 (commit xxxxxxx, repo_state=archive) of carv_e (CAR-V on 16 PEs and application E on 4 PEs of the 4x5 mesh, release mask 88462) at F_CLK = 434.912 MHz, 11.5 ms of platform time, Questa 2025.3, riscv64-elf-gcc 12.2.0 (_heap_size 50036 bytes), 2026-10-14 (make -C experiments/multiapp sim). Analysis: make -C experiments/multiapp analyze check-run (rttools.paper.rtlapp --app CARV --composition composition.json). Task BFE3 (PE 4, 0-1) runs iterations 1 to 6 and stops before the start of iteration 7 (no scheduler event after its ITER end 6 at 6,200,492 ns; the packets of FBU3 queue up); PE 4 halts at 8.2 ms with irq2_handler(): out of memory (logs/MA.output-0-1.txt). Responses: iterations 1 to 6, all below R_bound; the CPU windows after 6.2 ms and the counts of the PEs of the pipeline of BFE3 reflect the stop.
